dedupe_keys.name: swot derived canal observability confidence levels for asian green revolution irrigation networks

description: The dataset assigns SWOT observability-confidence levels to GRAIN canal segments across 22 countries in and near Asia's Green Revolution regions, using open-water satellite observations from 2024. The metadata is published or maintained by Sharma, Mridul (provider deposit/publication). Coverage is canal segments across 22 Asian Green Revolution and adjacent countries, using SWOT observations from 1 January to 31 December 2024. The provider landing page describes access to CSV material. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The inspected public record or source repository is free to read; this does not grant rights beyond its stated licence. Caveats: Independent reuse and ongoing maintenance were not established; admission depends on the open single-study rule. For infrastructure simulation, its documented contents can support network flow. These are catalogue-use assessments, not additional validation claims. The provider describes GRAIN, Global Registry of Agricultural Irrigation Networks (irrigation canals from OpenStreetMap). Related catalogue records are data-grain-global-registry-agricultural-irrigation-networks.
